"""Copied into a Codex workspace; exposes validity feedback, never a score."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import uuid


def main():
    workspace = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    config = json.loads((workspace / 'context.json').read_text())
    root = Path(config['evaluator_root'])
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'src'))
    from proof_eval import Evaluator
    from proof_eval.metrics import validate_candidate
    from validity_feedback import build_validity_feedback
    code = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
    evaluator = Evaluator(root / 'data/benchmark_data_warmup.jsonl', root / 'environments.local.json', root / '.proof-eval')
    row = evaluator.dataset.get(config['name'])
    try:
        is_original = validate_candidate(row, code)[0] == validate_candidate(row, row['src'])[0]
    except ValueError:
        is_original = False
    if is_original:
        references = evaluator.get_reference(config['name'])['versions']
        if any(r['status'] != 'prepared' for r in references.values()):
            raise RuntimeError('Prepared reference unavailable')
        evaluation = {'status': 'passed', 'per_version': {v: {'status': 'passed', 'passed': True, 'diagnostics': []} for v in references}}
    else:
        evaluation = evaluator.evaluate(config['name'], code, versions='all')
    feedback = build_validity_feedback(evaluation, config['required_versions'])
    evidence = workspace / 'validity_checks'
    evidence.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (evidence / (uuid.uuid4().hex + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'code': code, 'feedback': feedback}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(feedback, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha hb =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
      exact ⟨x ⬝ y, .par hx.1 hy.1, .par hx.2 hy.2⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha]
      exact ⟨b', .red_I b', hb⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha
      rw [hx.2]
      exact ⟨x, .red_K x b', hx.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha
      rw [hx.2.2]
      refine ⟨x ⬝ b' ⬝ (y ⬝ b'), .red_S x y b', ?_⟩
      exact .par (.par hx.1 hb) (.par hx.2.1 hb)
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      exact ⟨a₁', ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .red_K a₁ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rw [hx.2]
      exact ⟨x, hx.1, .red_K x c'⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [hx.2.2]
      exact ⟨x ⬝ c' ⬝ (y ⬝ c'), .par (.par hx.1 hc) (.par hx.2.1 hc), .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _⟩
